review: One of the two IDs from which season 7 has started. As a Tremor-Sinking Hybrid, she is leaning more towards the Sinking unit category by providing more utility to Gloom-oriented damage than the Sloth one. Contrary to expectations, she is not spectacular and merely serves as an alternative for the Sinking team, rather than a direct upgrade. To explain this, let’s look into her kit. Starting with her unique effects, she has 3 of them - "The Udjat [Vanguard]" essentially gives some protection, 3 Haste, and makes the enemy roll worse. Some skills would perform better if Outis has this effect.
